# Teen Vogue

> Teen Vogue is a leading digital media destination for teens covering fashion, beauty, entertainment, news, and lifestyle with celebrity interviews, trend guides, and exclusive content.

Teen Vogue, part of Condé Nast, delivers culturally relevant content spanning fashion trends, entertainment news, wellness advice, and social issues for a teen audience. The site combines editorial coverage with shopping guides, horoscopes, and exclusive celebrity interviews.

## Key Topics

- Fashion trends
- Celebrity interviews
- Entertainment news
- Teen lifestyle
- Beauty and makeup
- Astrology and horoscopes
- Shopping guides
- Teen wellness
- Pop culture
- Style advice
- Netflix content
- K-pop
- Olympic coverage
- Relationship advice
- Prom fashion

## Core Sections

- [Teen Vogue Homepage](https://www.teenvogue.com): Teen Vogue homepage with fashion, beauty, entertainment news and lifestyle content
- [Fashion](https://www.teenvogue.com/fashion): Fashion trends, runway coverage, and style advice for teens
- [Entertainment](https://www.teenvogue.com/entertainment): Entertainment news, pop culture updates, and celebrity interviews
- [News & Politics](https://www.teenvogue.com/news-politics): News and politics coverage including current events and social issues
- [Wellness](https://www.teenvogue.com/wellness): Health, wellness, relationships, mental health, and astrology advice for teens
- [Shopping](https://www.teenvogue.com/collection/shopping): Curated shopping guides, deals, and product recommendations for teens

## Fashion & Beauty Trends

- [Spring 2026 Fashion Trends](https://www.teenvogue.com/story/biggest-fashion-trends): Spring 2026 fashion trends including minimalism and texturemaxxing
- [Princess Pink Nails Trend](https://www.teenvogue.com/story/princess-nails-trend): Princess pink nails trend featuring Mckenna Grace at Oscars 2026
- [Rosy Brown Lipstick Trend](https://www.teenvogue.com/story/brown-lipstick-trend): Rosy brown lipstick winter makeup trend guide with celebrity examples
- [Best Prom Dress Websites](https://www.teenvogue.com/story/best-prom-websites): Guide to top prom dress shopping websites and retailers for teens

## Entertainment & Celebrity Coverage

- [One Piece Season 2 Cast Interview](https://www.teenvogue.com/story/one-piece-inaki-godoy-charithra-chandran-march-april-cover): One Piece season 2 cast interview with Iñaki Godoy and Charithra Chandran
- [Hannah Montana 20th Anniversary Special](https://www.teenvogue.com/story/hannah-montana-20th-anniversary-special-everything-you-need-to-know): Hannah Montana 20th anniversary special guide featuring Miley Cyrus
- [Off Campus Prime Video Exclusive](https://www.teenvogue.com/story/off-campus-first-look-exclusive-interviews): Exclusive first look at Off Campus hockey romance on Prime Video
- [BTS ARIRANG Comeback](https://www.teenvogue.com/story/bts-2026-arirang-comeback-tour-netflix-everything-you-need-to-know): BTS ARIRANG comeback album, tour, and Netflix partnership details
- [Alysa Liu Olympic Gold Interview](https://www.teenvogue.com/story/alysa-liu-olympic-gold-teen-vogue-cover-interview-2026): Alysa Liu Olympic gold medal interview and cover story

## Wellness & Lifestyle Guides

- [Weekly Horoscope](https://www.teenvogue.com/story/weekly-horoscope-for-march-16-22-2026): Weekly horoscope with astrology insights and cosmic events
- [Questions to Ask Your Boyfriend](https://www.teenvogue.com/story/questions-to-ask-your-boyfriend): Curated list of questions for relationship conversations and dating
